spec.title: Hi-Vis Vest Safety Monitor
spec.description: Alerts when a worker in view has no hi-vis vest and shows how many people the camera sees right now.

widgets.title: Workers without a vest, last 10 min

limitations: Forklift counter not added: the model only detects person_with_vest and person_without_vest. To count forklifts, retrain it with a 'forklift' class (label forklifts in the training images). A class_count KPI 'Forklifts in view (now)' can then be added. It would be a per-frame count, not unique forklifts.
rationale: The dashboard stays the same because forklifts are not a detected class. A forklift KPI needs retraining with a forklift class first.
